meta.title: Undergrowth screenshot catalogue
meta.author: hello-nova-claw
meta.description: The plugin with the e2e test provider, Hebrew, and the en_XA pseudo-locale. Used by playwright.screenshots.config.js.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/translation-install.php';

if ( ! wp_download_language_pack( 'he_IL' ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'Could not install the Hebrew language pack.' );
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . WPINC . '/pomo/po.php';

// Compiles the pseudo-locale written by bin/pseudo-locale.mjs, so the
// catalogue needs no WP-CLI download.
$po = new PO();

if ( ! $po->import_from_file( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/undergrowth/languages/undergrowth-en_XA.po' ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'Could not read the en_XA catalogue.' );
}

$mo = new MO();
$mo->set_headers( $po->headers );

foreach ( $po->entries as $entry ) {
	$mo->add_entry( $entry );
}

wp_mkdir_p( WP_LANG_DIR . '/plugins' );
$mo->export_to_file( WP_LANG_DIR . '/plugins/undergrowth-en_XA.mo' );
